methods_quotes.q: Categorical data comparisons were performed using the chi-square test or, when cell sizes were <5, Fisher's exact test.
Nonparametric testing (Wilcoxon rank sum test) was performed when continuous data were not normally distributed.
Where pairwise testing was performed, the step-down Bonferroni-Holm correction was applied
subsequent analyses of medical outcomes and specific clinical signs and symptoms focused on children aged ≤5 years
